def load_workspace_0207(root: Path) -> list[dict]:
    records = []
    for path in root.rglob('*.json'):
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            records.append(json.load(handle))
    return records

type load_workspace_0207Props = { projectId: string; pending: boolean };

export function load_workspace_0207Panel(props: load_workspace_0207Props) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const visible = useMemo(() => filterRows(query), [query]);
  return <section aria-busy={props.pending}>{visible.map(renderRow)}</section>;
}

def load_workspace_0316(root: Path) -> list[dict]:
    records = []
    for path in root.rglob('*.json'):
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            records.append(json.load(handle))
    return records

def load_workspace_0503(root: Path) -> list[dict]:
    records = []
    for path in root.rglob('*.json'):
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            records.append(json.load(handle))
    return records

type load_workspace_0503Props = { projectId: string; pending: boolean };

export function load_workspace_0503Panel(props: load_workspace_0503Props) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const visible = useMemo(() => filterRows(query), [query]);
  return <section aria-busy={props.pending}>{visible.map(renderRow)}</section>;
}
